text: Subject: Severe lag, freeze, and fake network issues after 4-5 consecutive matches (Memory Leak Bug) Hi Shadow Fight 4 Team, I am facing a persistent issue while playing Shadow Fight 4: Arena. After playing 4 to 5 matches continuously, the game starts lagging heavily, hangs, and constantly shows a "Network Issue" error. However, as soon as I restart the game, everything goes back to being perfectly smooth for the next 4-5 matches, after which the same problem repeats.

Personally I am loving this game, I am addicted to it, though there are some areas where programmers need to improve like adding new characters, buying characters using coins and gems permanently or on temporary basis. Prices for buying monthly pass are too high. Last but not the least gaining rewards through ads is quite frustrating instead add some challenging tasks, but overall excellent graphics and great gameplay

This game is extremely disappointing. No matter how fast the internet connection is, it constantly shows “poor network” and eventually forces me out with a message saying can’t continue due to bad connectivity—and marking me defeated even when I’ve won a round. Shadow Fight 2 was a classic, but this sequel feels like a waste of time and only causes frustration. Please fix your servers. Giving 1 star just for the smooth UI and graphics.

Very disappointing experience. I spent ₹360 to purchase the Raikichi character, but due to a connection error, the item was never delivered to my account even though the payment was deducted successfully. I contacted support, shared proof of payment, and waited patiently, but received no response, no refund, and no assistance. Taking customers' money without delivering purchased items and then ignoring support requests is unacceptable. So, I cannot recommend spending money in this game.

One of the worst experiences. Fairness is completely missing. What’s more frustrating is the unfair gameplay: despite having a stable connection, I was still getting hit by the opponent’s moves while they seemed unaffected, ultimately leading to a loss. Overall, this was an extremely disappointing and frustrating experience.

The biggest problem in Shadow Fight 4 is unfair matchmaking. I am often matched against players who are much higher level and have stronger gear, making battles feel impossible to win. When I do get similar-level opponents, many of them just camp, dodge, and run instead of fighting. This makes the game frustrating and less enjoyable. Please improve matchmaking and add better anti-camping measures so matches feel fair and skill-based.

This game doesn't handle online multiplayer like most games do. In most games, you can benefit by having low latency (ping). Not to mention frequent pauses if your opponent (or yourself) experiences packet loss or high ping.

Servers kind of suck, but it's still fun. Progression can be tedious, but that's expected from any mobile game these days that is ftp. Shadow fight 3 was better in terms of customization. This game has The best potential to be one of the best fighting games. The arcade control make it very comfy and nostalgic. However, The matchmaking is sometimes unfair and Its sometimes laggy. The currency systems is also kind of pay-to-win. Moreover, The systems make you lose so you play more and more. The systems do this is by modying the duration/Animation of Actions. This is very hard to notice, but i have done my experiments and survey. I expect better, a more fair gameplay and systems.

I've moved between countries. Now I'm unable to find any ranked fights for any mode. 1v1 or 3v3. It simply keeps asking me to fight with AI opponent. How can I get players from my current location join for 1v1 or 3v3 modes. Also, tournaments don't give a match for long time. I have to wait for 5+ mins to get a match opponent. Finally, when I trigger a duel with a friend from the friend list it doesn't start. Always shows that the duel had some error. This is frustrating. Can this be fixed?

Not only is it a repetitive game with little to no variation in gameplay, but it's ruined once you start figuring people with paid characters. Paid character have better combos, more advantageous perks and, since you don't have them and don't know their moveset, are really hard to find openings if they have any. From characters reviving to unfair shadow attacks. It's just not worth it for the Free to Player.

I'm given low priority when I have full bars with 5G. There's nothing wrong with my connection. That's silly. This game is fun. It doesn't work correctly all the time though. Lowered the review unfortunately as I'm getting low priority on my perfectly fine home wifi... This is a flawed system. There are other fighting games that handle this much better.

The tutorial is so God dang long it doesn't make sense, it makes you fight maybe 10 times before you can make your own decisions. Wish there was a to skip it. I had to fight, switch characters, check out the store, level up, and download some more content before getting to make a decision it's a bit ridiculous. I finally just deleted the game so I honestly have no idea how much longer it goes on for, the whole game could be like that for all I know.

This game is surprisingly fun. The one thing I think should be added is the story mode for each different characters, so that we can all learn more about them much better. And if possible, you could also add some story mode to make the game even more awesome. But I do have one issue. When the description of some unique skills when it exceeds 3 lines, it won't complete all of it, one of the example is Sarge's "Old School" ability, Hilda's "Power of Light" & many others. Keep up the good work!

Multiplayer but it takes time to load and comes with an internet connection error message. And I play call of duty and master duel so there is now way my connection is the problem. I've tried to play my friends on here and we barely had matches. Maybe one after 5 to 6 attempts. I'm olaying from south africa I don't know if it's a server thing or not. Otherwise, it's a great game. The graphics are awesome. The mechanics are top notch.

The A.I in this game sure is great... but that's all it is... Player versus Computer. I left the game to continue work at my job. When I was on break an hour later, I resumed the game, and my opponent continued fighting!! There's no way that would've happened, had my opponent been an actual person! You know how bad it feels to go from thinking your opponent is a person, to finding out the hard way that it's nothing but A.I? Same with SF3, although SF3 was way better than SF4.

I enjoyed the game up until last night. Once I entered June's plane I hated it. I can't upgrade the weapons I use. Only low rated ones. So it doesn't only hinder the story mode, but also facing other people. I find ways to beat stronger opponents online, but they keep getting stronger and I have to stay the same. I don't want to be forced to use terrible weapons or have to pay for shadow energy to upgrade those terrible weapons. I am extremely disappointed and won't be playing the game anymore.

Take a look at the real reviews before buying, there's truth in them. The lag on any connection is enough to make you lose, so keep that in mind. It says no pay to win but the first message you get in game is that making purchases on characters an Resources can make things "easier." in a game focused on online pvp anyone with common sense would understand what that means, no matter what response the devs give to that. Gameplay is good too. Prepare for all your opponents to just walk back.

You don't get to create or even customize your character like you could in SF-3. You don't even get to chose what weapons or armors to fight with. All we get are cards and that's it. I was really hoping a lot of 3 went into this one, but it seems to fall bland and generic just like the rest of failure games in the app store. At least it's kind of a good looking game, despite its inferiority.

This game has gotten me interested for a bit, but there is a frustrating issue. Lets talk about an irritating problem though. I recently got myself into the new character gamemode, and decided to give myself a try. When I did, I was met with such a different playstyle exploiting ever nook and cranny of the combat system I swear. And these players just love to give an akward 37 seconds of wait time for you to pick quickly if you dont want to be akward, please make a sort of divide, casual, sweat

Character leveling is extremely slow. New characters are nearly impossible to get without paying—feels like a game for rich players. Character kits are locked and hard to obtain. Same-character matches lack uniqueness, making gameplay repetitive. Now, it's getting boring. I have more to say, but the 500-character limit stops m

I thought this game was good at first play but then realizing the future, it sucks now. There can't be shadow fight 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and so on. Just make one shadow fight game, let's enjoy the longevity. Let us stick to one game and keep improving it, if it happens, it'll be the best fight game on mobile. And try to get a console and pc version as well, build one good game.

The absolute terrible game the match making process is very wrong when I am progressing the rank of the match making algorithm match with higher rank players and the game crashing sometimes when my device is flagship phone but the game still lags

Gameplay is fun and addictive. The problem is the amount of ads in the game. You can't earn enough gold without watching any ads it's so annoying. It's almost impossible to level up a character by just simply playing the game. But you need the ads to get extra coins, and I hate that. Progress should be possible by just playing the game. Without the ads it will take forever. My advice? Follow on Clash Royale's model. No ads, make the gameplay fun and give incentives for buying your season pass.

Great game, but losing my account ruined the experience I’ve been playing Shadow Fighter 4 for a long time and really enjoyed the gameplay, graphics, and progression. It’s a fun game with smooth combat, and I put a lot of time into leveling up my characters. However, when I changed my phone and logged in with the same email, the game treated it as a brand-new account. All my progress, items, and characters were gone. There was no obvious way to restore my old data, and it feels like I lost.

Good graphics and gameplay, lots of originality and variety which is always good. My complaints? Pay to win, extremely pay to win, as in, even if you pay you're going to get no where unless you pay more. And even then you're going to lose to someone who payed more than you.And most of the players are annoying to, they don't play, all they do is hit you and wait for it to time out so you die, if you're gonna play this game then just play story mode

so tired of games that have a 45 minute forced intro. waste of time and space. ffs let people skip past the 17 forced fights you have to "learn" your basic game. Edit in response; there should be an option to skip the tutorial. this game is not so challenging that it requires a handholding session to start it off. leave it in for inexperienced players, but don't assume your entire player base needs that level of basic instruction in what's essentially a very basic game.

It's a really good game, with a lot of potential. But the problem is the "pay to win" strategies. Sometimes, I'm paired up with someone who's bought legendary characters. These characters do massive damage in their shadow mode. Meanwhile, my character—Fireguard—only does hundreds of damage in his shadow form. Instead of overpowering the characters, maybe you can make them cooler than ordinary characters? That way, it's fair competitively.

Great game. One major flaw. This account I'm commenting on is the account I downloaded the game with. Signed into the game with. Yet it's trying to charge a different account that doesn't have any payment methods. It's quite annoying. Especially because the connect Google Play button does literally nothing. Please fix this. Also I don't know what's happening in these tournament things, but these matches against Top% players, suddenly drop because of connection, when my connection is flawless.

I've spent alot of time playing this game, I unlocked a bunch of heroes plus when I started at that time I bought the starter pack cause I loved the character it featured (Kibo). I took a break from the game though for a time. Yesterday I was looking forward to returning but it seems my gamedata no longer exist??? Cause when the game loads up its like I have no savedata registered so it starts up a new game, now no matter what I do, it only reloads that new data from today. Very disappointed.

the game is awesome, and I like it. but the crash issues are overwhelming for me, while other online 5v5 games don't crash for me, when I play 3v3 online in sf4, it crashes after a game or two. the game also sometimes crash during loading of the story mode. In conclusion, I don't know what the issue is, but the game crashes a lot for me, and I've lost hundreds of trophies to technical defeats.

The game is pretty fun, and the combat feels fluid and engaging.... however, the game is 100% pay to win... You will spend most of your time (99% of the gameplay) fighting other players. Basically, who has the higher level hero wins automatically, and it is not even close. It would've been alright if we were talking about sf2 or 3, which are mainly singleplayer games. The only way you will have fun in this game is by spending cash, until you find someone who spent more than you.

I have changed my rating for this game. I still think it's a great game, but after having it for years I have concluded that it is a money blackhole. You can spend your entire salary here but still be where you where when you started. There's no progress or the progress is small. There's been changes made over the years, but the changes only went towards making the game take more and more money and NOT towards making the gamers benefit. A few more plays then I'm uninstalling.

Unfortunately, the higher you climb the more the game becomes pay to win (or rather pay to get an unfair advantage) Ive had multiple instances where I'm playing the exact same character as someone else, with the exact same stats and level and skills. Yet because they bought a skin, they get a 1000 extra health? The devs will probably say that I can earn those skins by grinding the game. But I like many other people, don't want to spend hours just to have an even playing field with our enemy.

Game seems like it might have a good core in there, but the monetization is extremely aggressive and feels p2w even early on. The myriad pop-up ads are extremely annoying as well. It's a shame, I want a good fg for Android and would be fine spending a reasonable amount if that put me on the level and stopped the constant 'new bundle' spam. Edit: You CAN spend nothing, but it sure won't feel the same for the first year or so of progress 😜

Game itself is an 8.5 out of ten, amazing game. But I never thought they would stoop so low as to fake gameplay in the ads. I just saw an ad showing shadow fight 3's character customisation and SF 4's gameplay, as if they are the same game. Shadow fight 4 has absolutely no character customisation. The characters come prebuilt, and you cannot change anything about them except the color. That was a shock from a game I loved playing, it's disgusting.

At first I thought the game play was cool, but after a few weeks of playing, this game is stupid asf. The game play is still OK but the over all game itself is horrible. It's almost impossible to get new characters with out buying them with real world money. Constantly being played against players that are way above in level. Rewards for winning are pretty much nothing. Even upgrading the two characters they let you have, is almost impossible after a few times. Sorry but this game is just dumb.

The game has been good so far. The only issue I have with the game is that there were a couple of background or theme songs or 'music' that I loved so much but they disappeared after I updated the app. The songs were titled 'Market new year' and 'Market new year2'. I would like to ask the game development team to reintroduce these two theme songs. Thanks

Great game. Graphics are solid, gameplay is fun. Few bugs but that's to be expected in soft launch and none are game breaking. Biggest issue that will kill this game is timed loot boxes and capped daily rewards. 10 fights a day give small amounts of gold and every 4 hours a chest. Needs to be adjusted to give some form of incentive to continue playing. This isn't coming from a f2p complainer either. I don't mind paying something to play as long as it's fair. This is just over the top by a bit.

This is an insult to the shadow fight series. In tournaments, it seems every player has a legendary or two except you. If you have bad wifi for one game, you get put in low priority groups, so you basically can not play. It is pretty much pay to win. The characters do not have their canon weapons and armor sets and set bonuses, and paid characters are faster and spammable.

Game is good. But it's unfair to another level. They match you with someone who has 1.5 times your health and strength almost everytime. Even if you're good, it won't matter because there's only so much damage you can do right? For instance, my health is 1600 and every opponent I get has a minimum of 3000 health, sometimes even 4000. The game is rigged to get you to spend money. Ridiculous.

Kind of annoyed. I subscribed to pre-download the game, I signed up on the website with my character name and did all the "quest" get the the launch day rewards. I didn't get anything... Which is fine let's lodge a ticket to support... Oh wait there's no way to contact them, and the "live chat" is a auto reply bot feeding from a FAQ. Aside for that, game is pretty boring and character movement + controls feel slow and clunky

Game is fun. But good luck leveling up your characters. Make money watching ads to level up and spend endless hours obtaining shards to level up. Don't count on earning new characters. The two you start with are okay and you can get pretty skilled with them but a game like this needs variety. Unfortunately, you need to either play endless hours grinding the hell out of it or fork up the cash to get that variety. Too monotonous a game to spend money on though.

I barely played 2 ranked games in a single day because of "slow connection" I was always on wifi or 5G. I managed to play Call of Duty on the same network connection that Shadow Fight4 deemed to be slow. After about 1 minute of searching for an opponent, I was always redirected to an AI opponent yet my network connection was always top. I'm being very honest. I just Uninstaller the app. kindly fix this. otherwise the gameplay is top notch and the stories more difficult but interesting.

I had high hopes for this game, as the last three were great. I was very disappointed. This game gives you a little fun in the beginning, but then it just isn't. It pretty quickly becomes a pay to win game, and the ranking system for the arena isn't balanced well. Pretty soon, you'll be forced to pay ridiculous prices just to get ahead, and I'd rather go broke spending money on several other games rather than this. I do like the graphics and some of the gameplay, though. I am uninstalling this.

The graphics are good, the only thing is that after playing for a few weeks it stopped doing match making at all in 1 vs 1 matches (just black plane screen) as well as in 3 vs 3 matches, where it gives you an option to fight with AI opponent instead of real gameplayers and if you don't choose it, it goes plane as well, others than that, if it would've been like from the beginning, I would've given 5 stars. I also made purchases of top tier heroes, so am very frustrated, you can imagine.

The directional input is garbage. So much so that it makes this game's bad network and input delay slightly more tolerable. There has been so many times where a move would come out that I didn't even do because this game just gets confused with directions and there are times where I would literally hold forward and the game makes me jump - like what the hell. Trash until it's fixed. Also, the balancing in this game is okay but still needs improvement.

The gameplay is pretty solid. However, that's pretty much all there is. It's insanely grindy and barebones. You start with 2 characters and it would take an ungodly amount of time to unlock any new ones if you don't want to spend any money. The story mode is near impossible without either spending money or leveling your character like crazy (which is hard to do for free as well). The "PvP" mode is clearly against bots. Would not recommend unless youre willing to spend $10 on a stupid battle pass

I've always been a fan of the Shadow Fight series. This game takes the series to another level. The combat is as expected, easy to figure out and simple. The graphics have improved compared to Shadow Fight 3 and the animations look better. The concept of heroes fighting your battles is good but it would've been better if character customizaion was a thing. Too late to change it now. Other than some occasional crashes on online PVP (which can be fixed), I love everything about this game.

Great game, graphic UI, mechanics. Inconsistent controls (you mve forward, it moves backwards sometimes, very unpredictable), bad transition between scripted mves (especially when final hit throwing down the opponent, and he tries the stand up), cheating AI (it knows what we pressing for sure, with a reaction not comparable with human speed, this is clear particularly with throwing knifes), some characters are very unbalanced, especially Chang (over powerful), and emperator (under).

Nice graphic, design, and physic engine but this is just another pay-to-win game. Main story is incredibly difficult and time consuming unless you pay for boost, buy energy, and/or level up your characters, which takes hundreds of 1v1 matches. On top of that, it takes several hundreds more to unlock new characters, which is required to progress in the main story. So unless you "subcribe", the game is mainly just you playing countless 1v1 matches with little to no progress in the main story.

The combat is really good. BUT the money grabbing nature of this game is insane. Pay to win... pay a lot to win!!! You will get frustrated because when your close to ranking up you start matching with players several levels above you. Even if you are more skilled they will land three hits and kill you. Characters are way over priced. Want better weapons ..it will cost you a lot. Want to rank up?? Guess what?! And grinding it out takes forever ever!! It's a money rabbit hole. Don't fall in!!

Really enjoyed it. It's combat felt much more fluid than the older games and the capability to switch to another playstyle easily made it great for me. Though there is one problem that really took my attention. Just when I posted this review, my game crashed when I'm just one step to gaining five wins in an event. I'm not really mad about, more like I expected it. I'm not sure whether the problem is on my device or the game itself, but I want it fixed ASAP if it's on the game.

I've played a number of the titles in the past and this is the worst one. Instead of a character you can build and equip yourself, you have premade characters. There are a lot of them but you won't play any of them without spending money. You get 2 of the jump and that all you get. There's so many ads and different currencies it tries to trick you onto spending money. The paid tournaments pits you against the top 34% of players that can't be beaten.

Actually this game is pretty good, there's no problem with graphics and the gameplay, it's pretty good, But during some time of playing, there were a lot of freezes, I thought it was because of my device so I tried to lowered the graphic, but eventually after I lowered the graphics, the same problem still occurred, the freezes is not only about the movement but the sounds, i love this game but i need to uninstall this, the freeze really bothering me, please fix this cuz I really love this game

I like this game, really do. but I don't really like to get too much into spending real money on the game. however, when the new king of the legion legendary skin came out, I thought it looked awesome. I didn't have the money at the time to buy it, so I held out until recently when the roulette came back. I must have spent around $60 on the roulette for that skin, and got everything but. then when only the skin was left, to roll again cost $43. and the bundle is worth $50. I feel scammed.

love the gameplay, characters, and graphics. But here are some ideas to make it even better: 1. Add in-game chat and voice chat. Let us talk! 2. Give us add request button to play again with the same player easily anytime. 3. Bring in some cool weapons from Shadow Fight 3 like Kusarigama, Sabers, Nunchaku, and Halberd. These changes would take the game to the next level. Thanks for listening and keep up the great work!

This game has only very cowardly players who like to walk backwards against the wall to wait for enemies to come and then the counter is not fun at all. Too cheating. This game is pay to win. Developers like to claim that they don't send. The effect on the game depends on the player's skill. The skill of the players is the same, but the damage is not the same, anyway you lose. Basically a copy of Shadow Fight 3 but with some minor tweaks to game play leading to a worse experience. You are forced to play specific characters with little to no customization. Much of the variety of the older games has been removed leaving a husk of what once was. After playing I found myself continously frustrated by the player base and lack of content available to those that don't pay endless amounts of money. What was once an enjoyable game of skill has fallen into a pay to win trap

The overall gameplay is very good but there are some problems:- 1) The new shard system is too much grindy and time consuming. The old unlocking talents with just levelling up was great. Due to present system, we have to purchase seperate crates for heroes and their shards. 2) It takes a lot of time matchmaking (averagely more than 2 mins), so fix your game. 3) Campers and spammers constantly let your morale down by playing unfair. It's very frustrating and there seem to be no system for them.

The game itself is very good. It is fulll of unique style of fightings and strategies. But there is one thing which is bothering me for a long time now. After finishing every match or after watching every advertise, the game hangs for a few minutes. It does not recover by itself, rather I have to close the game and restart it. Sad Part is, I am doing it for a year now almost. I thought the developer will fix such a major issue because we always get updates. But no, till now, the problem remains.

The fighting is really fun, until you realize you'll have to spend money to compete eventually. I've been playing this game for years now and still am unable to unlock many characters above the rare level no matter the events, story and ranked I play. The characters you can buy have overall much cooler, better abilities and skills then the ones you can actually unlock without paying. I love this game, thats why I've played it so long but it really is pay to win and it gets discouraging at times

It's a really good game honestly, and it offers what other PVP game's don't.The only issues I've experienced are matching making difficulties. It takes forever to find an opponent, and I mostly end up fighting AI opponents, apart from specific time Frames, where you can get the chance to fight actual non AI opponents.And frequent crashes, and bugs. Put all that side , great game. Please developer's, fix this.

Overall, i like the game's concept and everything so far. But I'd really appreciate it if the developers thought or considered adding the ability for players to have in-game friends, which i think will make it easier to fight and play with your friends. And if there was a clan system, it'd add an awesome touch, in my opinion, so there would be clan fighting events, etc.

Great game. Really fun, has great graphics and i enjoy the narration and the story. The matches are fun and I really enjoy the different characters and the playstyles they offer. However, for some reason as soon as a character has rank 6 or above and it changes to silver, i am unable to find a match and it says network error, yet works perfectly well with other characters rank 5 and below. Really makes the game annoying and impossible to play. Please fix this as i really want to continue playing

Amazing game, and very addictive, just one thing tho. Like I've read in other reviews, it gets kinda limited after awhile and there's nothing new. One thing that could fix this and I think a lot of people would love is including leagues and individual ranking systems that rank us up against local players as well as international players, that way we always having something to work towards and you don't run into the problem of it getting boring after awhile.

It's a good game. Not the best but good. I reached a certain rank and suddenly the only opponents i can play with are AI opponents. No real players. There should be a world chat option where we can add friends. Or send game invites to other players. Moreover can there be a battle royale mode where we go in and fight with other players. Lastly I hate that every bonus card is an ad. That just sucks.

I highly suggest the devs bring back being able to change weapons and armors ect. The characters are too hard to get and the game just feels limited this way. The characters should still stay and maybe the have better skills in certain weapons, but not being able to customize isn't fun at all. And most of the players you're matched up against are really bad. Kind of feels like AI. I suggest you download shadow fight 3. Way more fun and more possibilities because of customization.

The fighting mechanics are simple enough so the learning stage is manageable but still being entertaining. However, it is a heavy pay-to-win game. It gets very difficult to keep going on the arena at a certain level if you decide going with the two free characters. I do recommend this game specially if you are willing/able to put some money to it. Otherwise, you may encounter a hard break in your progress.

this is literally the only "fighting" game I play. the controls are very simple, each round only lasts a couple of seconds and no daily log in requirements, which is perfect for a non-gamer like me. they have in game purchases but I can still enjoy it w/o paying huge fees. I started w SF2 and am amazed by how far the team has developed this game. I really liked Lynx's design and even contemplating whether to "purchase" him lmao. he had no business looking that c*nty I'm sorry

The game is fire, but the 3 stars for 2 reasons 1. Stuff is a little hard to get without a lot of ads (this by itself is no big deal), but 2. ads glitch, like a lot, maybe every 5 ads 3 would not give you anything (i waited for the "reward granted" and even for the whole ad) so without the 2nd problem I will rate it 5/5 Edit: they fixed it.

READ THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS! THEY SELL YOUR DATA TO 4 COMPANIES INCLUDING AMAZON. but wait, there's more! - connection to servers is horrible. many ranked games end in connection issues or pause the game even with very strong wifi. - versus mode does not balance encounters at all. Many games will have you go up against players who are much higher leveled in EVERY way. - ads either bug out the game or give 1 small reward per 12 ads you watch. - bug support is non-existent. - unbalanced heros.

algorithm show unfair, i was hardly to find opponents when i used high level heroes, then when i found opponents most of their levels are much higher than mine. On the contrary, when i used low level heroes, there was easy to find opponents and of course they have higher level than mine and also full talent. How can i win in this situation???uninstall is the best way i choose

One of the worst fighting games, the ranking system is very bad, every character has it is own rank so chances that you just starting with weak, start of the game characters and have to face people with epic and more powerful characters that have various skills and power ups. Plus there is only 2 modes to play, story which you have to survive for 12 rounds and rank and that's it, there is no much play styles and much diversity. It takes a lot of time to get another new character.

Eh, I'll stick to GamePass and emulators, unless you buy characters - ranges from $15-$30 depending on character - it took 1 week to even get 2 fragments for another character, which means you're stuck with the 2 default characters the entire time because of that it got boring after the 2nd day. Thought this would be something quick to play every now and then, nope. Uninstalled as I can just load up GamePass or an emulator and play any different fighting game that has a full roster to pick from.

Absolutely terrible. This game match maker is god awful. It get to the point where if you don't spend money to make your character max level you will just get stuck with people who did. And you won't stand a chance because their level is higher therefore their damage is higher, health is higher, and defense is higher. If you want to play a game that you will enjoy and don't have to spend money on is shadow fight 3. DONT PLAY THIS GAME.

Great game, however sometimes matchmaking takes too long. EDIT: They either fixed the issue or something happened on my end I'm really not sure. But matchmaking is quick now. Now my only complaint is the unfair matches I get. But maybe that's due to how good I got. I win about 95% of my matches but no matter what character I play I'm the disadvantaged one. It also takes forevvvver to level up or skill up your characters without paying. P.S I am 2 yrs in an currently rank 60 on the leaderboard.

The game overall is very good. But past a certain point, enemies (player and AI) just spam the same fast, unblockable attack over and over again. Some of the characters are really over powerd and not fair. Some, like I said, have unblockable attacks that are too fast to evan react to. Some have a super ability that no matter where you are hit you. And around 2 have an ability where when they attack, they take no damage or stagger back, and its constant. Please balance this game.

There's nothing much I can complain about with this game, the graphics are good the combat is fun, all characters have a very unique style which makes me wanna get them al, nonetheless, the difficulty of the matches I've played so far are just a bit too easy, I have bad network so I can't really enjoy this game much with other players, but it saves my data unless I change characters when fighting the AI offline. Why not make another offline arcade game similar to this with a difficulty setting.

It has good graphics; i like the characters, moves, and weapons. Also the controls are easy. However, there is only one thing that ruins the entire game. This game is not a multiplayer game; you are not playing against real people. And i can tell that because you can pause during the fight. There is no multiplayer game where you can pause during a match. Every opponent is a bot in this game.

Most unbalanced game ever. Matchmaking is purposely picking easy opponents and then you get enemies higher with +3 or +4 level to make you lose. I've had 2-3 matches where the level was equal. Also the other characters are a lot stronger then the starter ones. What is the point if there are 2-3 overpowered characters and the others are useless? What is the point to add skills in a game like this? Add customizable moves like mortal kombat and done. The Ui is bad and also the characters.

Really fun while it lasted. Pay to win, comes a certain point where everyone is higher leveled, have better characters, and better equipment. Takes an extreme amount of skill to beat them and not worth the time in my opinion. I love the shadow fight series but not enough rewards are offered in the free version. Makes for a very slow, boring, buggy game that I regretted playing after a while. Great game, great mechanics, great fun. The pay to win aspect is annoying and the developers know that.

I did give it 4 stars but then I got to silver rank 7 on all my characters and realized that everyone past that point just pays to win and the game becomes almost unplayable if you haven't spent money on it. Wouldn't really recommend this to anyone unless you are ok with paying to win. I've played more now and it really doesn't get better. A lot of the higher level people just back away from you to get you into their combos that almost instantly kill you.

This game is unplayable for me. I decided to reinstall the app after a few weeks of having it deleted. Everything was fine until it said " Something went Wrong, Please try again later". I tried waiting, clearing my data, and even deleting the app, but nothing has worked. It's been doing this for about 2 days now and nothing has changed. It wasn't doing this when I had it installed a couple weeks ago and I'm using the same device too. Do you know how this can be fixed or if I can talk to someone

Don't waste your time. Disappointing pay to win game. Most of the characters are not balanced, you run into alot of people just spamming the same ridiculous move. It is fun when you fight someone else that isn't juiced up on characters and abilities that they paid for, but that is rare. Also, matchmaking is horrible. I recently fought someone with almost double my health. Is your matchmaking really that poor? You would think a simple algorithm could prevent these types of matchups.

After one season of playing daily about 3 hours everyday and spending approximately 100$, I can't play the normal mode because the opponents are just way too strong. I will have to pay another 80$ or even 100$ just to upgrade all of my characters (that I don't even want or like to play with) just so that I can level up and increase my basic stats. The shards (some points that help you unlock special abilities for your characters) are EXTREMELY difficult to get and you have to open a lot of RNG!

Do not download this game. This game gives you so much frustration as, in the beginning, u r able to enjoy the game, experience and fight. However, as time goes on, u will suddenly be facing opponents that r 10x better than u, mocking u. Now I may seem like a cry baby, but it also seems that there r a few bugs in the system. Not to mention that the money squeezing is crazy. U have to pay tons to just level up and get new characters. There are other games out there. Play them and not this.

shadow fight 4 is incredibly fun. the characters are unique and different. there's a gamemode you can play pve. the characters are generally balanced. it's fun. the biggest issue is the monetization. gone are the days of buying the premium version of stick fight 2 to support the devs and enjoy more of the game. you need to level up your heroes (in two different ways) for them to get damage, health, and in some cases incredibly important abilities. I just can't recommend with that scheme.

Shadow Fight 4: Arena is one of the best fighting games out there. It's realistic and mechanical — you can truly feel the characters' movements and strikes. The graphics are also very realistic and immersive. However, it would be even better if the events ended sooner and new ones started more frequently. Overall, I would rate this game 8 out of 10.

This game is good, no doubt! First time I downloaded it, I got addicted that I played it from morning till evening nonstop. But as I ranked up my players,I discovered that once you're above rank 6/7, the connection becomes bad and the searching time delays. And that is the only problem I've found so far. I hope Nekki can do something about this as soon as possible!

Ok lets go. The only real fighting game that looks good and plays good. You need to choose the right attacks at the right time, calculating distances, learning attack patterns, a complete fighting game. some things could make it even better imo, faster rolls and ducking, though changing those, will change the game's concept dramatically. well done.

This game had a lot to live up to, especially since SF3 is such a great game. I like this game. I kinda hoped to fight as my SF3 character, but I didn't really expect to. My only issue is the controls. They also are unresponsive sometimes. It's a new game, I get it but when i need to do a perfect timed roll or hit, i fail because the controls arent fast enough for me. Same thing with the shadow abilities. Otherwise, I am so glad to use my skill against real players!

Honestly, i loved game. It was fun. All new characters with different abilities was so fun to try out! As soon as you get to higher trophies, it is starting to get boring. I dont even understand how are you supposed to play? People play passively and try to grab or punish and inflict ton of dmg or you play passively and still get punished. A lot of characters have really fast moves, broken abilities but others don't. Also block break in fighting game is ridiculous. I hate playing now. Deleted.

I've not enjoyed this game for one bit, I mean one bit. It keeps asking me to "download additional data to continue playing and get rewarded for your patience" and after downloading the 2GB sized "additional data", it begins loading so that I can start play, then repeats the same process of downloading additional data, all over again. I'm not pleased with it at all. I'm now thinking that those 5star reviews were all automated.

Bro fix your matchmaking. The meet up against opponents is so bad. Though I would love to leave a five star rating, the matchmaking is the big issue. I'm at dojo level 7 and most of the opponents I get are like dojo level 10 or 11 or higher. I rarely get people that are on my level. It actually makes the game feel so much more boring. no matter how clever I attack, just a couple of hits and I'm gone. please fix this matchmaking issue. (edit : it's gotten better to say the least ❤️)

The game itself is quite nice. The problems arise when you want to play PvP or against your friends. Ranked at first is fast but the further you progress, it'll start taking 5 minutes, 10 minutes and at one point just stop giving you enemies in which case you'll have to fight the AI opponent. Then there's the issue when playing with friends.. the servers for this game are so bad that no matter how good of a connection you have.. you won't be able to play with your friends due to "Bad Connection"

As a player that enjoys Shadow Fight 2 growing up, this game has potential but some of the characters and gameplay makes me don't wanna play this game. But you need to do something about the blocking mechanic like make it a way so that a player have to move the joystick back in order to block an attack or create a button, automatically blocking without moving sounds good but it creates people that doesn't want to move and there's little to no chance to punish them for it.

Was super fun at first but then you realize something is fishy with how some players can destroy you before you can even blink an eye. I'm pretty good at video games so I was a bit surprised when I started losing alot after a couple days of playing. Seems like unless you spend real money on characters and add ons you'll get destroyed

Man, I bet this game would be fun if I could get a new character. Too bad that I am always matched up against people who have paid money to unlock a character that just out plays the basic starting characters. I only win about 30% of matches so I can't really get anywhere. Shadowfight 3 had the same issues you could play it free but until you bought something to get you going it was a horrible horrible slog. I like SF 3 now but only because I actually have the means to progress

Hi, I played the game for about 2 months ,the original shadow fight was my favorite game when i was younger, and i have to say , they've came along way, the game improved in several aspects, such as, graphics, storyline, characters and much more, not to forget when i used to play there wasn't multiplayer at first , and we only could play on 5 lives, for a time , for them to recharge , that's about it , there's minor problems like battery consumption but it's not that bad!

The gameplay itself is super impressive and got good graphics. But the options for the players are limited. If you can put the add friends feature where a player could send a friend request to the player he competed in his previous fight, that would be an amazing improvement. And an offiline mode will be good too. And also you could add a chatting feature and voice messaging in the distant future (no pressure ;-)

Good points : Game is good, graphics is almost on par with pc fighting games, game mechanics are great but unbalanced. Bad points : Unbearably pay to win, to the point where even the hero level is based on chance. Power level jumps from level to level, even if you're just a level or two behind, you'll get pummeled not because you're bad at the game, but because the damage and hp difference is just so high. Also, there's a bug that will kick you out whilst in match for no reason.

although the gameplay itself is good this style of gacha game has no place in the fighting game genre, not only did it feel limited on the ways you can actually earn things but the game is not shy at all about reminding you and giving you new bundles to buy, and they aren't cheap either. I saw some go as far up as $15, and in a game with different rarity of characters as well as leveling them up to get extra perks and abilitys, it almost garuntees the one with the fatter wallet is going to win

I'm a fan of the other Shadow Fight games, but this one falls short. This is another collect hero shards to level up your team grindfest. The other games, while still pay to win, at least let you buy gear and weapons to customize your fighter, but now you're forced to use their "hero" characters. You end up with a game that is more pay to win with less customization and no story. It's a shame really. You should've stuck with what makes these games great and made Shadow Fight 4 instead.

Rewards are given out via "roulettes" that are rigged so that the desired item always comes last, and then they hike the price up to $40 (!) for the final spin. The idea is that you'll pay it because of the already sunken cost. Even if you don't ever plan on spending a single dollar (good luck), ask yourself if you want to play a game run by that kind of developer. UPDATE: they responded to this review with a lie. I asked them for a refund and they refused.

Unbalanced. Unjust. The devs have just everything for sale in game, with the exception of maybe the air that you breath while you play. numerous bugs and incredible lag. The matchmaking system is broken. the game gives you easy wins at first and when you feel like you have the hang of it, it suddenly matches you up against extremely difficult foes.

Incredibly skill based....to a degree U can pretty much just buy character shards, camp at a low level, and just easily beat everyone. Also why is there a blocking feature when there are heroes that are just able to ignore the block? Some heroes have attacks that will break through your block on the first hit. It's not very balanced. Take it from someone who's been playing MK for over a decade and has beaten every souls game.. It is skilled based but, it's also P2W.

So this game is pretty disappointing, the gameplay is decent, but it is entirely pay to win. the game is totally unbalanced, with new heroes costing over $20. Going back to unbalanced, one group of characters have abilities that let them attack without being able to be interrupted, where the rest of the characters have seemingly no additional abilities at all.

The game is cool and has the online mode that we were all asking for but it has some delay. I am not sure if it was from the game or my internet because it happens even if i was playing vs AI (which is pretty much always) or even in training mode There are differences between the fighting mechanics of this game and shadow fight 3 (what made pretty upset) In the end i think it is the only problems i had with it so if the developer saw this i wish you will fix it somehow 👍🙂

Haven't played for long, but I had a great time with a game. Pretty good for a free fighting, matches are with people on the same training, so PtW isn't strong here. Not at early stages at least. Didn't had any problems with connections, matches are found pretty fast, less than a half of minute, it's same even without a wifi, just a mobile data. (Sorry for my English, not a native speaker)

This game was less than 1GB on initial install. A few months later, and it is over 8GB. I've played it maybe once or twice for no more than 1 hr. I've never had this happen with any other games or apps, especially the ones I don't ever use. Anyone that's played more than 5mins of this game should know there's zero chance it contains 8GB of content. I find this exponential growth to be incredibly suspicious and I'll be uninstalling the game immediately until I get an explanation.

I have played a lot of fighting games and even enjoyed the other games from the developers. This one though, is a bit too broken for my taste. There are clearly some balance issues that negatively impact the game. No matter your skill level you will often feel that the game favor's specific characters with its current available mechanics. I managed to abuse a specific character and leveled up quickly without much effort. If you seek a proper chalenge, play something else.

It is honestly a great game, the graphics are great, the hitboxes are realistic, and the voicelines! The only thing which ipsets me is the matchmaking between players, but it really depends on your skill. 8/10. I recommend this game. (especially for ppl who like p2w) but theres a problem where it shows im lagging when my wifi is working perfectly fine. if i lose to a technical defeat, atleast dont make me lose trophies, it would be unfair.

Really good game. There's nothing much to it. If you want detail, I can talk about how the "Shadow Pass" is a little pricey or how matchmaking isn't that good, (atleast for me) but those are very minor things that don't ruin the game play. The only thing I don't want to see is pay to play heroes, so please keep it that way and I'll stay happy.

This game have issues with connection. It seems I cant play because each WIFI connection I use is weak yet Im sure it is strong enough. It used to work in the first run but as days come then these issue came can't play anymore with 'friends' and 'Ranked'. You could find a way to adapt the game, on different connections. Overall great graphics,(with a capable device) and fight experience.

It's nice and all, but the slow response time from when you press the attack button and the movement it self is too slow, you just can't counterattack in time. The searching time for a player is kinda long, on average 2 min. If the other player has a poor connection the match is paused and the lag from his connection affects you too. The game is awesome but connection problems screws things up.

The game is fun but it is so extremely pay to win and unbalanced. 90% of the time if not all the time the person with the higher rarity character will win and it is basically impossible to get better characters without spending money. I understand having characters that may be better than others but to the point where you basically just automatically lose because of better mechanics and stronger abilities is crazy.

The dev's attempts to make you pay for something are so aggressive I'm sure they must be self-sabotaging. Constant pop-ups, updates that increase the number of clicks you need to do, rewards for in-game actions are pathetically small. Matchmaking is broken - if you play well expect to constantly play with opponents with 2x all your stats and experience. I could say more, but the review limit is small. In short, the game is garbage and anything good about it is borrowed from Shadow fight 2.

The game is great and all but the only issue for me would be the server's forcing me to play against opponents that has an advantage over my character!? Or anti character! I have been playing this game for many years so i know what I'm talking about! The multiplayer mode is not fair at all! always matches me with the same enemy heroes that my character trouble coping with on PURPOSE! This is usually why my waiting time lasts forever, not because the server can't find same rank, they d

PAY TO WIN basically. You hit a wall once you reach a certain level. After that, you get destroyed by players that buy better characters or better abilities. It's fun in the beginning, and the graphics are good, but the reaction time of the cursor is really slow and you can't upgrade your character unless you pay. I had my cun, but I'll uninstall it now.

It's a good game, the graphics and the fighting style, my problem is with the connection, sometimes you win a round and it says round was won illegally, and sometimes it freezes and it closes, I launch the game several times when playing. You guys should fix it because thats the reason why I would stop playing the game. But apart from that, it's a fun game to play. Two stars.

Gameplay is good, though the progress is extremely slow and matchmaking is inbalance. Game is skill based so inbalance matchmaking wont be an issue except if you encountered players who has an extreme access to pay the game. You can choose whether you want to be competetive or chill. The only problem if you decide not to pay is you will get bored as there are less to none content you can play on the other hand. Overall Average but not a main game to play.

The concept is cool... Graphics are awesome...But overall I feel like it's really lacking what made Shadow fight Unique...The huge collection of Locations and music from SF2 AND 3 are lacking here...and even out of the eleven maps you have in the trophy road, you have only added five during the launch and never added any more. Plus the balancing is horrible...I would give it a five star of you'd try to bring out the core Elements from your previous titles...

Based on gameplay and graphics I love this game, it is quite addictive and fun with the fight features. But sadly one can not fully enjoy the game or progress on developing your fighters without in-app purchases, so if you are not willing to spend a lot of money buying fighters, weapons, card upgrades and stuff then I will not recommend this game, Shadow fight 3 is way better than this on that note.

The game is good but: 1. Friends Invitation Marathon does not work! I invited four friends, everyone downloaded the game, got their training and downloaded 1.5 gigabytes, but won the reward for two, the support didn’t answer anything and the award as I understand it is no longer available! 2. The game is very slow, you need to watch a lot of ads to get something and to pump the account faster. 3. The plot is very difficult, without mascots it is not possible to pass for 5-10 attempts.

Fix the fknf matchmaking in ranked. Just 1 in 6 matches is correct, comparable level. The rest is only vs 4+ levels over, there's no contest. Or at least if you can't find proper matchmaking in while searching make a prompt in game - "can't find suitable players, extend search to greater level differences?" so players can make an informed choice.

Watch an ad for guaranteed shards! Except.... It's gems.... Every time... Everything else is great.(edit) Found out you need to watch all of the ads for the shards. The 1/2 looks like a limit, not a requirement. I'm still leaving it a 3 star since there are a few overpowered characters. Overall, it's a good game. It's just not 4 or 5 stars. Changing to 2 stars for the poor response. I don't need more information about broken characters. Not to mention the p2w cosmetics.

Very heavy pay to win. Terrible matchmaking First day of playing: slow progress, hard to get gold, not sure how to get other characters freely. Second day of playing: bought battlepass, instantly so much easier game. However, tournament events are very unbalanced, my first day i went against players who had skins, know every combo for every character. Seems that the matchmaking does not exist in tournaments. The problem is that you need to WIN tournaments to get currencies to buy new items.

So I've been playing Shadow Fight since it first came out. Loved Shadow Fight 2, Shadow fight 3 was okai but this game is horrible. Controls suck, the gameplay is really slow compared to others and it makes the game really unfun when you get stuck in a corner not being able to do anything but die. If I wanted to play this, I'd just download Shadow Fight 3. Atleast that's better. Also the tutorial is hard. Like I'm getting my but kicked in there. Just horrible

No words can explain how much I like the series. I've been playing Shadow Fight since it was only available on Facebook. And this is the best version of all. The visual graphics. The controls. The dedicated weapon and move sets for every single shadow (character). I love em all. I admit it's hard to get new character without spending a single penny. But this version's worth a small part of your game expenses.

I went back to give this game another try and it's just as disappointing as I thought. The game has become heavily Pay To Win, can only fight PvP for so long before the game puts you up against someone who has spent more money than you and forces your hand towards buying $20-$40 characters. On top of that, you have to spend maybe $5-$15 to upgrade said characters and then an extra $15-$20 more if you want to keep going. Definitely a huge step backward from SF 3

Pretty cool, nice concept and could go far; however, provide the option to skip your little forced "Captain Obvious" click-dummy tutorial in the beginning. Not every gamer is a Gen Z kid that needs a "For Dummies" handbook. I almost uninstalled the game in utter frustration, especially at your last pop-up piece of click-hell titled, 'Have fun!'.... Like, can I play the game now, please? Jesus.

So many great things about this game. But there are issues. Like, how does the AI always, but I mean ALWAYS have a faster attack than me? Or of you launch a heavy attack, but the AI just kinda extends his foot a little bit at exactly the right time (of course it's at the exactly right time, because it's AI), and sends you flying. Needs a bit of work to make it fairer.

Here’s your text translated into English while keeping the meaning and gaming context intact: As a relatively experienced,I recommend placing or displaying the win rate of characters somewhere for a better experience for example, showing what percentage of players have won with that character overall, whether in 3v3 or 1v1 matches. It really increases the excitement. Also, make sure the character doesn’t completely stay out of range so that until we’re ready to target them so our time is wasted

I have been playing this game for 4 years. The matchmaking is the greatest worst . I get defeated by annoying campers and max-level players. After a series of losses, I get matched with low-level players for two or three games, then again it's back to the annoying campers and max-level players. It's like a loop. This game never shows me players of my same level.Please add report option.

A rare thing i reviewed an app, its either the app is good or bad. In this case its bad. Why? The matchmaking system is just imbalanced as hell, first of all i queue myself (level 5 character) against a lvl 7 character, you might think its fine but damn the big difference is the health and the opponents attack damage. I kept getting the most unfair matchmaking to the point that i should delete the game for my own sanity. Please fix the damn matchmaking issues!

Over all its a good game. However when your charakter reaches rank 6 or above, You cant find any opponents for some reason. And reaching level 6 takes about 1 to 2 days of dedicated gameplay. So have fun for those few days. Because after that the game is UNPLAYABLE. Also note for those who want to spend money. Spend it elsewhere. Because you will only be able to play your premium charakters up to level 6. So keep that in mind before you buy anything.

As a long time fan of the original shadow fight, i was very happy when i discovered this game. The graphics are gorgeous and gameplay is fun. After getting addicted to the game a bit and leveling up my heros, i started getting alot of mismatches (players 2+ levels higher than me) which put me at a massive disadvantage. The difficulty of the story mode also needs adjustment (the 2nd level is harder than the 3rd for example). all im enjoying this game a lot

If you wanna have fun playing, pay. If you wanna progress in the game, pay. If you wanna play a different character, pay. I saw many replies from the developer to a negative review. All of it would be like "It's all about technique, skill play, or timing", "There are a reward from event and quest to improve your heroes" with no mindset to improve character balances. There is a hero who can spam unblockable attacks and can revive when defeated. Also, the rewards given are nearly worthless.

The more I play the more I feel like it's a pay to win game. For free to play players you can't win against those with purchased heroes. Kept getting stun locked and couldn't fight back. Some had invisibility on the entire match. The in-game purchases should only be cosmetic and not some special perks to boost winnings chances. Overall, bad experience. Pls don't download.

The game sucks. It's extremely pay-to-win and the characters you can buy are more op that the standard fighters. Opponents can win but just spamming an unlockable or fast move, and playing to get a decent fighter takes way too long. If you wanna have a fun experience don't play this game, it's rage inducing and just all around trash. Nekkisays in-game purchases don't affect battle but thats a lie. Fighters bought, are much better then normal fighters in all areas

A pretty solid game. Good gameplay and graphics. Each character is unique so you actually have to think about your moves and not randomly mashing your screen. The game's very grinding though if you don't want to spend money on it. It's a mobile games after all. For the developers : like others have said, it would be nice to have leaderboard and friends system, also some stats so we can review our past games

Didn't expect to enjoy the game this much because the fighting style isn't what I'm used to. I was pleasantly surprised to find it easy enough 2 grasp with enough nuance & depth to build skill in. I can actually go toe to toe with someone who's thrown a bunch of money at the game and come out victorious, with skill alone. Advancement is fast-paced & very rewarding (coming from a brokie) 2 the devs: THANK YOU 4 making the game free 2 play friendly. I'd write more, even give 6 stars if I could.

The game is great. You dont need to spend money to get stronger. I played for a month I already have 7 heroes. You can watch ads to get shards. Having 10 shards will unlock that character. So its free to play. The matchmaking system could be upgraded further. We might be lacking in players. So gamers get on the game. It won't be a waste. I guarantee you. Well for the graphic the size could be a bit much. But its completely free to play. Enjoy.

I've had a good time at the very beginning, the first few matches. After a while you realize how badly unbalanced each and every heroe is. Some of the heroes are so overpowered, while some are legitimately useless. Also, not to talk about the matchmaking. The opponents and the heroes they have in those random pick events. You have to play with common heroes against players with epic and legendary. Do not recommend the game, sadly.

The game is amazing—the graphics, the heroes, everything. I even bought Itu for its OP attributes and unique skills. However, the matchmaking system is a problem. My account is Level 6, yet I’m matched with Levels 8-9. How can I win against such skilled and experienced opponents, especially when they also pay to win? I get that skills matter, but sometimes they aren’t enough in these unfair matches. Please fix the matchmaking, or you risk losing many players’ interest in the game.

This series has steadily been on decline and this new entry is no different. No story mode, only online battles with characters that you can buy ( or grind through the free battle pass for hours). Edit do to dev response, If it's still in development you shouldn't being monatising like you have been. If you are testing things out then the players using your unfinished game are providing you a servise by play testing for you. In thanks you charge them for every single thing you can. It's sad.

The perfect game to test your shadow fight skills and I love it. Nekki you have really outdone yourself this time! There is a small problem, the controls are 🤔 sticky. And it's hard to get cards for new characters if we 1 don't have money to buy gems and 2 if we only receive cards for characters we already have. Also I can't redeem promo codes and I fill like I'm missing out on a LOT of rewards.

Super Good, we need more online active players though. A few minor bugs here and there. It's not pay to win, its primarily very skill baised with very cheap in-app purchases overall 8/10. We need AI bots on tournaments, so the loading time isn't so long. You pay 100 gems to enter, then there's no one to play. Also, more social features for adding friends and making a team(Clan or Guild and competing together would be awesome). Keep up the good work guys. Also, advertise the game better.

Pretty good, but there are these ads that you have the option of watching and it has the words "Guaranteed Shards 0/4" under them. The shards are really awesome, so you watch the ad thinking you'll get one. It also insinuates you can do that 4 times/day. But more often than not you get regular in-game currency. A little false advertising. DEVS need to re-word that so that it doesn't sound like you'll get a shard for the ad. OR EVEN BETTER, give us a shard the first 4 times we watch those ads.

Every match seems to be vs NPCs, which just sucks. Moves are a bit slow clunky, with no flow between them, but not terrible. Adverts are either broken or their provider forces you to open up the Play store when you click the cross, which can cause the game to reload. There seems to be more of a focus on advertising things to you than anything else.

This rpg PvP/A.I. is by far the best when it comes to graphics and the mechanics of it. The warriors and the skills they perform are really remarkable for a mobile phone. I'm so impressed with it. I've been a on and off player since it's beginning on play store/with *Shadow Fight 3*. But, it lags and gets really slow at times. I don't know if my phone is a low end phone or not. So, that's why only 4 stars. Fix the lag and we'll give up 5. I recommend this console grade fighting game to anyone.

This is a really good game, very realistic and great graphics. However, the download size is 137mb, yet, after 4 (so far) on game updates it's now 4.4GB. Would be much more reasonable and easy to download it all before playing the game rather than being stopped half way through for 4 consecutive updates. EDIT: There is also no visible pause button in the game. Obviously it isnt available in online but it's not in training or vs computer etc

the gameplay itself is good. But the game is so incredibly predatory. You unlock points to level up characters through lock boxes which contain random character level up or talent level ups. When you are about to level up a character you tend to play a lot, you almost never get those materials for the character. but the game conveniently has that character level up or talent up material pop up for a straight up buy. if i could say more about the predatory monetization I would.

This game would be great but something needs to be done about the ease of defense in this game. Try putting the defense level at a minimum. Most of the high leve players are campers that just hit you a few and times and then wait to counter(campers) anyone can win like that. So annoying ,so cheap!! It ruins the experience of an otherwise great game. Fight and let the best most skilled player win. Why would I spend money to improve my fighters if some low level noob camper can still win this way

The game is nice but runs very slow. It has a lot of lagging and takes much time to go to the next screen. Taking a long time to find opponents and preparing for the battlefield is like forever. Very very very very very slow. And their reply to this was unbelievable. "Try running on Wi-Fi or 4G?" So they think we are dumb to run on 3G? The opponents in the events are like way too high. If we are at the top 50 , they gonna be around the top 12. What the heck is this matching? So uncool.

Love the gameplay and graphics! Developers did a good job with everything. But getting a new hero is nearly impossible, unless you play at least for 2-3 hours every day (still, you can't unlock some of the best heroes without purchasing them). Occasional players who don't want to spend money will eventually lose interest after a couple of days. As a F2P player I faced this problem...

They really ruin the game, I've been playing for about 1 1/2 years and during that time they have really Nerf the game a lot!!! Giving you less and less rewards so you can spend real money to get them. You can't even grind anymore without spending some real cash!!! This game used to be so fun and exciting and used to be so creative. Now it's just a pile of cash for the developers!!! Don't play this game unless you like spending money 💰!!!

Ever since this update...THIS GAME SUCKS HORRIBLY!! I used to get into PVP fights that were evenly balanced and still challenging. Now everytime I play I'm against someone who is 10x better with characters that are maxed out and im a level 6 ,of course I can't get a hit in before they kill me. I also noticed when ever I'm close to winning a fight somehow the match glitches out and I'm dead within seconds. Please for all things holy fix this game!

[Replying after the Developers' answer] I get that big time that the game is skill-based. I didn't even say anything about this particular point. Because there is no issue with it. I talked about THE PROGRESSION SYSTEM (the game economy). It's NOT player-friendly right now.
